text:
oncall-bot: ALERT: apiserver liveness failing eu-central-3 cp-host eu-cp-3-02 (3 restarts in 6m). auto-escalate.

reema: noticed controller-manager leader flapping and a pileup of GPU onboarding jobs - many pods stuck ContainerCreating.

viktor: apiserver logs show etcd timeouts around 09:42. snippet: `E0319 09:42:13 handler.go:210] etcdserver: request timed out`. healthprobe showing context deadline.

alex: metrics: etcd_disk_wal_fsync_duration_seconds p99 spike at 09:41:50 on eu-central-3. NVMe host had transient IO wait. dashboard: https://metrics/etcd/eu-central-3 (internal).

tara: infra noted a kernel dev error on host eu-cp-3-02 at 09:41:52. opening INF-6490. recommend draining cp host or removing from LB.

reema: temp mitigation: `lbctl set-weight eu-cp-3-02 0` and restarted kube-apiserver. controller-manager leaders stabilized and onboarding queue started draining.

viktor: root cause hypothesis: short NVMe fsync tail causing etcd WAL latency -> apiserver probe fail -> controller-manager leader churn -> onboarding controllers retry too aggressively and amplify load.

opsbot: ACTIONS: [remove-lb-eu-cp-3-02], [collect-smart-dmesg-eu-cp-3-02], [rate-limit-onboarding-controller]. assignees: reema, alex, tara.

reema: follow-ups: add host I/O alert for nvme tail latency, increase apiserver liveness grace in this zone to avoid flap-on-spike, add exponential backoff cap on onboarding controller. finance note: routing onboarding to dedicated capacity has cost impact.

opsbot: INCIDENT: mitigated via LB weight 0 + apiserver restart. tickets: INF-6490, SRE-6167, SRE-6168.
